articles.title: An undercover Google analyst infiltrated a notorious supply-chain hacking gang
articles.content: Google’s threat intelligence group said it had a mole inside TeamPCP's inner circle.
articles.titleZh: 一名卧底谷歌分析师渗透了一个臭名昭著的供应链黑客团伙
articles.contentZh: 谷歌的威胁情报小组表示，它在TeamPCP的内部圈子里有一名间谍。

articles.title: LLMs respond differently to harmful prompts when AI watermarking is used
articles.content: SynthID can cause models to follow harmful instructions they would otherwise refuse.
articles.titleZh: 使用AI水印时， LLM对有害提示的反应不同
articles.contentZh: SynthID可能会导致模型遵循否则会拒绝的有害指令。

articles.title: Nonprofit that tracks meteors taken down by "critical blow" from a cyberattack
articles.content: Group plans to be largely out of commission for several weeks.
articles.titleZh: 追踪因网络攻击而遭受“严重打击”的流星的非营利组织
articles.contentZh: 集团计划在几周内基本停止运营。

articles.title: AI bots "Timmy," "Ren," and "Jackie" are flooding social media with slop

articles.title: No Dogs in Space is back to feed your need for obsessive music history
articles.content: In August, I wrote about my love of the music history podcast No Dogs in Space, but mourned the fact that there hadn't been a new episode in over two years. Little did I know that hosts Carolina Hidalgo and Marcus Parks were gearing up to announce the show's return with season four, Punk 2.0. […]
articles.titleZh: 太空中没有狗回来满足您对迷恋音乐历史的需求
articles.contentZh: 8月，我写了一篇关于我对音乐历史播客《No Dogs in Space》的热爱，但哀悼两年多来没有新剧集的事实。我不知道体验达人Carolina Hidalgo和Marcus Parks正准备宣布该节目将在第四季《朋克2.0》中回归。[…]

articles.title: No one is surprised that Nvidia’s Jensen Huang thinks AI fears are overblown.
articles.content: The man who may stand to make the most money from the AI boom seems to think he knows better than anyone else, including researchers who have studied and worked on AI for decades. In an interview with CBS Sunday Morning, he claimed there was a "0% chance" of AI being the end of the […]
articles.titleZh: Nvidia的Jensen Huang认为人工智能的恐惧被夸大了，这并不令人惊讶。
articles.contentZh: 可能从人工智能热潮中赚到最多钱的人似乎认为他比其他任何人都更了解，包括几十年来研究人工智能的研究人员。在接受哥伦比亚广播公司周日早晨的采访时，他声称人工智能有“0 ％的可能性”是[…]的结束
